node_6.subject: An Lushan
node_6.description: This is An Lushan's plan for Sunday February 15: wake up and complete the morning routine at 6:00 am, eat breakfast and prepare for the day at 7:00 am, check his goods at the West Market at 8:00 am, meet with buyers and translators at the market from 9:00 am to 12:00 pm, have lunch at a nearby food stall at 12:30 pm, visit the tea house in the afternoon around 2:00 pm to exchange news with other merchants and potential partners, conduct business negotiations or inspect new merchandise from 4:00 to 6:00 pm, return to the caravan lodging before the evening curfew.
